artworks.title: Maunder's Fish Shop, Chelsea
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the exterior of a small shop or storefront. The scene shows a building with upstairs windows and a display at street level. People are around the storefront, which has a striped awning over the entrance and goods displayed outside. The drawing captures the texture of the building's facade and the lively activity in front of the store with a sketchy, impressionistic style. The monochrome palette suggests this is a pencil or charcoal drawing, giving the image a timeless feeling and focusing on the play of light and shadow, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Little Nude Model, Reading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: Printed with gray lines and shading on cream-colored paper, a slender, nude young woman sits on a partially drawn cabinet in this vertical lithograph. She is just left of center with her body facing our left, almost in profile. A kerchief covers her upswept hair, and some loose curls escape onto her forehead. Her legs are crossed, and she tilts her head down looks at an object, possibly a book, in her hands, held in front of her chest. She leans a little back onto a loosely drawn pile behind her on the cabinet on which she sits. Her body is outlined along the curve of her neck, back, belly and thighs. The contours of her body are delicately shaded within that outline, and the texture of the paper is visible. The cabinet beneath her is suggested with a few lines. A few curving lines could be a stylized vine and leaf decoration on the side of the cabinet facing us. A few vertical and parallel lines to our left could be another piece of furniture in the background.

artworks.title: The Dancing Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing and slightly turned to the side. The person is wearing a headscarf and draped in a long piece of fabric, with one arm extended. The sketch is monochromatic, done in pencil or charcoal on a light background, without any objects or additional details in the background.

artworks.title: Model Draping
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a nude figure standing in a partially covered pose. The figure is obscured by a sheer drapery that runs from head to toe, suggesting a concealed stance. The facial features are indistinct, with the head turned slightly to one side, and the hair appears to be loosely drawn atop the head. The sketch focuses mainly on the silhouette of the body through the draped fabric, with minimal clothing details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held in the image. The background is plain, with no additional elements, allowing focus on the pencil strokes and the primary subject within the linear boundary of the sketch.

artworks.title: The Horoscope
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated, leaning slightly forward with an outstretched arm holding a small object. The facial features are not clearly defined due to the rough style. The person's head is turned downwards, with hair tied back. They are wearing a draped garment resembling a long dress or robe. The sketch does not show jewelry, and the person is seated at a surface with indistinct objects, likely a table. The background is plain, without additional details.

artworks.title: The Novel: Girl Reading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper mounted to laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of a figure in a standing position. The person's head is slightly turned to the side, and facial features are not clearly defined. They are wearing a head covering tied at the back, with the hair obscured. The figure is covered in a loose garment resembling a robe or toga, with detailed fabric folds suggesting movement. No accessories are visible, and the background is plain, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Gatti's
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior architectural space with a high ceiling and decorative elements, including ornate columns and arches suggestive of classical architectural influences. The drawing features loose, gestural lines and a sketch-like quality. There are silhouettes of objects at the base of the composition.

artworks.title: Hôtel Colbert, Windows
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketchy, minimalistic depiction of a section of a building viewed from the front. The upper section of the composition features three panels, possibly depicting figures and decorations. Below, a solitary window with grid-like mullions is drawn with loose, freehand lines. The artwork primarily uses a monochrome palette, with soft gray pencil or charcoal on a cream background. The use of light strokes creates an airy and unfinished impression, giving the sense of a quick study or an artist's working sketch.

artworks.title: Cocks and Hens, Hôtel Colbert
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch displaying an architectural detail, potentially a building facade and a street scene from a low vantage point. The horizon is implied by the structure's base in the middle, vertically oriented with depth indication at ground level. Pencil strokes in an impressionistic style form the structure and details like a cart on the left and chickens to the right, creating a lively atmosphere. The grayscale palette on off-white background ensures focus on the sketch's lines without distractions. Faintly visible in the background are more structures blending with the surroundings. The sketch conveys a bustling everyday life scene with simplicity and dynamism.

artworks.title: The Garden
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered around a table. The figures are drawn with light, sketch-like lines, with limited details. A standing figure is in the center, surrounded by seated individuals. The table is covered with a cloth and holds various items. The background suggests an outdoor setting with foliage or trees. No explicit jewelry is visible in the image.

artworks.title: The Garden
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group seated around a table in an outdoor setting. The image shows individuals gathered at a table outdoors. The scene is illustrated with pencil strokes, indicating foliage and a casual setting. A table is visible with objects on it. The drawing has a light and airy quality, suggesting a relaxed gathering.

artworks.title: Vitré: The Canal
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a cluster of rooftops in a town or village. The viewpoint is elevated, showing a sweeping perspective over the roofs with a horizon lined by distant buildings, including a structure with a tower or spire. The artwork features soft, sketch-like strokes suggesting form and texture with a monochromatic color palette of black against a cream background. Near the viewer, rooftops and buildings are distinct, while those in the distance are less detailed. Reflections of structures can be seen at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Marketplace, Vitré
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a market scene. The image shows a marketplace with figures gathered around market stalls. The figures appear to be engaging in activities typical of a marketplace. Some figures are positioned beneath tent-like structures that serve as market stalls. In the background, there are outlines of windows and parts of buildings, creating a sense of an urban environment. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketch-like manner with minimal details, focusing on capturing the energy and busyness of the scene.

artworks.title: Gabled Roofs
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a building with steep, sloping roofs, reminiscent of older European architecture. The perspective is from street level, slightly angled towards the building's facade. The scene features soft, sketchy lines in a minimalistic style, with a monochromatic palette of black on a beige background. Additional architectural and street elements are faintly outlined, with minimal detail in the background, emphasizing the central building.

artworks.title: The Clock-Makers, Paimpol
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view of a building from the front. The focus is on the building itself, and there is no distinct horizon visible. The structure is portrayed with a soft, textured technique using light and sketchy pencil strokes, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is mainly various shades of gray against an off-white background. Several figures are seen near the building's entrance, which appears to be a storefront with a sign over the door. The figures are loosely rendered, providing a suggestion of people. In the distance, the upper part of the building displays windows and architectural details.

artworks.title: The Steps, Luxembourg
artworks.medium: lithograph in blck on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a staircase with human figures ascending. A woman with a child is seen climbing the steps, with loose and sketchy strokes defining their figures. A statue and other figures are present on the staircase. In the background, there are trees with bare branches. The sketch uses a limited grayscale palette and is executed in pencil or charcoal on paper.

artworks.title: Conversation Under the Statue, Luxembourg Gardens
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a scene with several figures seated in chairs and a statue on a pedestal in an outdoor setting. The viewpoint is slightly raised. The horizon line is not clear, suggesting an enclosed space like a garden. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, with minimal lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using dark graphite and beige tones. Various figures are seated, engaged in conversation, with some in the foreground and others around the central statue. Trees and vertical elements frame the scene.

artworks.title: The Pantheon, from the Terrace of the Luxembourg Gardens
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The drawing shows a scene from a slightly elevated angle, looking over a balustrade that runs across the center of the composition. The balustrade marks the horizon line, with several figures depicted on it, some standing and others possibly seated, engaged in activities. In the distance, a dome of an architectural structure rises, partially obscured by tree branches, suggesting a park or garden setting. The style is characterized by loose, sketch-like lines, suggesting a quick capture of the scene. The color palette consists of various shades of grey against a pale cream background, typical of a pencil or charcoal drawing.

artworks.title: The Draped Figure, Seated
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid Japanese vellum
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a seated person on a bench. The individual is shown in a relaxed pose with their head slightly bowed, obscuring their face. They have dark hair and are wearing a long robe. The background is minimally detailed, indicating an indoor setting. The shading in the drawing creates a soft and airy feel.

artworks.title: Nude Model, Reclining
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person reclining in a sideways position, propped on their left arm. The figure has delicate facial features and long hair with a headband. The person is nude, with a draped cloth behind them. The background is minimally detailed with faint shading, and the sketch is on a plain surface without other objects.

artworks.title: Nursemaids: "Les Bonnes du Luxembourg"
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a park scene with people. Trees dominate the horizon, with buildings in the distance. The drawing uses light pencil strokes on cream paper. People are depicted in groups with varying angles. The trees are detailed with textured lines, and statues and architecture are present.

artworks.title: The Long Balcony
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people on a balcony. Multiple figures are gathered along the edge of the balcony, most holding or gathered under umbrellas. Additional figures are seen peering out from small windows. The sketch is done with light, quick pencil strokes, expressing movement and casual observation. The background is lightly sketched, focusing attention on the figures with minimal detail given to the architecture, creating a bustling, everyday ambiance.

artworks.title: The Little Balcony
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream laid Japanese vellum paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a group of people on a balcony, approximately waist up, leaning or standing at the rail. The individuals appear relaxed, some looking outward and others engaged with each other. The sketch lacks detailed facial features or hairstyles. The individuals wear hats and hold umbrellas, hinting at the weather. Clothing is suggested through light shading and outlines with minimal detail. The background is plain and the setting appears elevated, like a theater or hotel balcony. Details are sparse due to the minimalist style. The focus is the gathering of individuals on the balcony.

artworks.title: Little Draped Figure, Leaning
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person leaning back with their body slightly arched and one leg crossed over the other. The person's head is tilted down, and their facial features are subtle. They wear a snug head covering, and their hair is short or tucked underneath. The loose, flowing clothing resembles a robe or long garment. In the background, there is a horizontal element the person leans against.
